blocks.raw: ## Modulr Portal | Beneficiary checking
blocks.text: Modulr Portal | Beneficiary checking

blocks.raw: In September, beneficiary checking (Confirmation of Payee) will be added to the Modulr portal. This feature will enable you to validate the accuracy of beneficiary information when creating them. This verification step ensures that the intended recipient aligns with the payment recipient. The service will verify:
blocks.text: In September, beneficiary checking (Confirmation of Payee) will be added to the Modulr portal. This feature will enable you to validate the accuracy of beneficiary information when creating them. This verification step ensures that the intended recipient aligns with the payment recipient. The service will verify:

blocks.raw:
* The account holder's name
* Account type (business or personal)
* Sort code
* Account number
blocks.text: The account holder's nameAccount type (business or personal)Sort codeAccount number

blocks.raw:
If the details you provide match the recipient's bank records, a confirmation message will be displayed. In case of discrepancies, an error message will indicate the issue.\
While error messages do not block you from proceeding with the payment, we strongly recommend exercising caution if the details provided differ from the recipient's bank records.

blocks.raw: ## Customer Screening | Sanctions
blocks.text: Customer Screening | Sanctions

blocks.raw: This change impacts partners who perform KYC themselves in an Outsourced KYC arrangement.
blocks.text: This change impacts partners who perform KYC themselves in an Outsourced KYC arrangement.

blocks.raw: We have introduced system changes which may impact a very small proportion of new and existing customers onboarded to the Modulr platform.
blocks.text: We have introduced system changes which may impact a very small proportion of new and existing customers onboarded to the Modulr platform.

blocks.raw: **New Customer Initial Screening**
blocks.text: New Customer Initial Screening

blocks.raw: All newly created customers are checked against sanction lists. Any entities that have a potential match will have their verification status set as REFERRED to prevent account creation and transactions.
blocks.text: All newly created customers are checked against sanction lists. Any entities that have a potential match will have their verification status set as REFERRED to prevent account creation and transactions.

blocks.raw: **These cases will be reviewed as a priority and we may reach out if we need further information.**
blocks.text: These cases will be reviewed as a priority and we may reach out if we need further information.

blocks.raw: Upon completion of our review, we will update the verification status to either:
blocks.text: Upon completion of our review, we will update the verification status to either:

blocks.raw:
* DECLINED – if the sanction match is deemed to be True
* EXVERIFIED – if the sanction match is deemed to be “False Positive”
blocks.text: DECLINED – if the sanction match is deemed to be TrueEXVERIFIED – if the sanction match is deemed to be “False Positive”

blocks.raw: Only once the customer’s verification status is set to EXVERIFIED can accounts be created for that customer.
blocks.text: Only once the customer’s verification status is set to EXVERIFIED can accounts be created for that customer.

blocks.raw: To be informed when the verification status of a customer changes, partners should subscribe to the [CUSTVSTAT webhook. ](https://modulr.readme.io/reference/addpartnernotification)
blocks.text: To be informed when the verification status of a customer changes, partners should subscribe to the CUSTVSTAT webhook.

blocks.raw: **Existing Customer Monitoring**
blocks.text: Existing Customer Monitoring

blocks.raw: All customers are monitored daily against sanction lists. Any entities that have a potential match will have a temporary block placed on their account to prevent transactions.
blocks.text: All customers are monitored daily against sanction lists. Any entities that have a potential match will have a temporary block placed on their account to prevent transactions.

blocks.raw: **These cases will be reviewed as a priority and we may reach out if we need further information.**
blocks.text: These cases will be reviewed as a priority and we may reach out if we need further information.

blocks.raw: Upon completion of our review, we will either:
blocks.text: Upon completion of our review, we will either:

blocks.raw:
* Release the block – if the sanction match is deemed to be “false positive”
* Permanently block - if the sanction match is deemed to be true
blocks.text: Release the block – if the sanction match is deemed to be “false positive”Permanently block - if the sanction match is deemed to be true

blocks.text: To be informed when the status of an account changes, partners should subscribe to the ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGE webhook.

blocks.raw: ## Modulr Portal | Email MFA to replace Authy Desktop
blocks.text: Modulr Portal | Email MFA to replace Authy Desktop

blocks.raw: We now also offer Email Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) as an alternative solution to Authy Mobile, for users who do not want to/do not have a mobile device. It replaces the Authy Desktop MFA solution that was retired in July 2024.
blocks.text: We now also offer Email Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) as an alternative solution to Authy Mobile, for users who do not want to/do not have a mobile device. It replaces the Authy Desktop MFA solution that was retired in July 2024.

blocks.raw: Email MFA doesn’t replace Authy Mobile, which is still available and supported.
blocks.text: Email MFA doesn’t replace Authy Mobile, which is still available and supported.

blocks.raw: **How it works?**
blocks.text: How it works?

blocks.raw:
* You can choose Email Verification as an alternative method when setting up your Modulr User.
* Once set up, when completing any MFA protected actions in the Modulr Portal (Such as Payment Approval/Payment creation etc), you will be asked to enter a verification code sent to your email, to approve the action.
